limitations: All twelve cited sources were fetched fresh on 2026-10-13 at about 14:24-04:00 with curl, using a Chrome browser user agent for HTML pages. Every request returned HTTP 200 and no retry was needed. HTML pages were converted to text with a local script and quotes were matched after whitespace normalization. XML entities in the metadata were unescaped before matching.

tutorial.zip was downloaded into an empty scratch directory and unzipped there. Quotes were matched against the source text of the code cells in aqr_extraction_tutorial.ipynb. Nothing from the download was executed. The zip size of 98,128 bytes matches the ScienceBase file listing.

The metadata XML is replaced as the dynamic release updates. The fetched copy was 36,592 bytes with edition 20261011, matching the ScienceBase file listing. A later checker may see a newer edition. The XML title says updated 2026-10-11 and the ScienceBase title says 2026-10-12.

Two conflicts between pages stay unsettled and are stated in the approved notes. Coverage start is 2015-07-25 on ScienceBase and 2016 in the metadata completeness report. The license is CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO in the registry and CC0 1.0 on ScienceBase and usgs.gov. The scene list S2_AQR_Scenes.zip was not read.

No cited page names who pays for reads in words. The three payer claims rest on unsigned access with no AWS account and on statements that the Open Data Sponsorship Program covers storage and sharing costs. The registry YAML has no RequesterPays entry. Phase B probes settle the payer.

Absence statements, such as 'No page states ...', were checked only against the twelve cited pages. A grep of the fetched registry, ScienceBase, metadata, usgs.gov, Marketplace, and sponsorship text found no mention of requester, STAC, inventory, shadow, or aot_estimate.

The metadata registry link https://registry.opendata.aws/usgs-sentinel-2-aqr-acolite-dsf returned HTTP 404, as the researcher reported. The metadata names bucket ngwos-rswq-development, which the registry does not list. It was not accessed.

Two metadata oddities are outside the claims. The spref block for UTM zone 17 lists central meridian -87, the same as zone 16. The NDWI entity lists both range limits as -10,000. Both look like typing errors in the source.

No S3 bucket was contacted and no aws command was run. Only documentation pages, ScienceBase files, the registry YAML on GitHub, the ACOLITE release page, and two raw ACOLITE configuration files were fetched.
